'''Thomas Hermann Geisser''' (born February 28, 1966) is a German mathematician working at [[Rikkyo University]] in Tokyo, Japan. He works in the field of [[arithmetic geometry]], [[motivic cohomology]] and [[algebraic K-theory]].

== Education ==
From 1985 Geisser studied at [[Bonn University]] under the supervision of Günther Harder and obtained a master's degree in 1990. He continued to obtain a PhD under the supervision of [[Christopher Deninger]] at the [[University of Münster]]; the title of his thesis is "A p-adic analog of Beilinson's conjecture for Hecke characters of imaginary quadratic fields".<ref>{{MathGenealogyProject|id=83699}}</ref>

==Career==
Geisser spent three years at [[Harvard University]] as a visiting scholar and visiting fellow, respectively. After further stays in Essen, [[University of Illinois, Urbana-Champaign]] and [[Tokyo University]], he became [[assistant professor]] at the [[University of Southern California]], and was promoted to [[associate professor]] in 2002 and [[professor]] in 2006.<ref>{{citation|url=https://www2.rikkyo.ac.jp/web/geisser/CV-neu.pdf|title=Curriculum vitae|publisher=Rikkyo University|access-date=2024-06-28}}</ref>

After visiting [[Tokyo University]] again, he became a professor at [[Nagoya University]] in 2010, and moved to Rikkyo University in 2015.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.rikkyo.ac.jp/science/math/staffs.html|title = 立教大学理学部数学科：研究室の紹介}}</ref>

He received a [[Sloan Research Fellowship]] (2000) and a [[Humboldt Prize]] (2021).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.humboldt-foundation.de/en/connect/explore-the-humboldt-network/singleview?tx_rsmavhsolr_solrview%5BpPersonId%5D=1058906&cHash=f7c3d8df94082f66cc50542a436dfc45|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210624203335/https://www.humboldt-foundation.de/en/connect/explore-the-humboldt-network/singleview?tx_rsmavhsolr_solrview%5BpPersonId%5D=1058906&cHash=f7c3d8df94082f66cc50542a436dfc45|archive-date=2021-06-24|publisher=Humboldt Foundation|title=Prof. Dr. Thomas Geißer|work=Singleview profiles}}</ref>

He is editor for ''[[Documenta Mathematica]]''<ref>{{Cite web |title=Documenta Mathematica {{!}} Editorial Board |url=https://ems.press/journals/dm/editorial-board |access-date=2026-03-31 |website=EMS Press}}</ref> and managing editor for ''Commentarii Mathematici Universitatis Sancti Pauli''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Commentarii Mathematici Universitatis Sancti Pauli |url=https://www2.rikkyo.ac.jp/web/geisser/commentarii.html |access-date=2026-03-31 |website=Rikkyo University}}</ref>
